notes.title: New theme-Physics!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33230583/058df85a01c310365a1991612a961b18b88f1c4f.jpg[/img]

Watts, Ohms, Joules, seconds...
Oh Yes! We have an important update! Added a new theme - Physics!
As well as minor fixes.

Physics is a topic for those who understand how different bodies interact with each other, what Ohm's law means and who discovered the law of universal gravitation.

notes.title: Campaign - Big update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33230583/a6b43176b42b3b62d9403c4c4aba16d8f1e39163.jpg[/img]

To make the quiz even more interesting, we decided to add to It the mode "on passing", that is - Campaign!
Now you can go through the game from beginning to end on paired subjects, gradually increasing the number of questions at each level.
For the passage of the Campaign you get extra points and new achievements!

Also, in addition to the new mode, we have added some new questions on biology and mathematics.

notes.title: Do not forget to write your opinion in the reviews!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33230583/47583b10c5f991a7253ad32a30e19a3b8f12b9b0.png[/img]

Dear players!
If you like our quiz, we would be happy if you leave feedback! It costs you nothing, and for the development of the game it is very important!)))
By the way, in the near future we plan to add a mode for the passage - a Campaign where you can arrange a real challenge and win, showing your knowledge in all disciplines!)

notes.title: Small Quiz update!
notes.content:
Today released a small but important update to our game)
In it, we have added the option "Show correct answer" to the wrong answer shows which of the answers was correct.
Just corrected a few mistakes on the issues.
Try!
Do not forget to write reviews and your opinions and suggestions for the game. This is important for us and we will try to improve the game as much as possible!

notes.title: A new theme - History!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33230583/c10ad763fa40c670c07ff5c7f153636f732fbe72.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/905150/Trivia_Quiz_All_about_everything/
Do you like to study dates and key events in the world history? Do you know who Alexander the great, Napoleon and Kutuzov are? Then you here! 
A lot of questions about the history of primitive people to the present waiting for you in the new game theme.
Enjoy, learn and remember!

notes.title: New theme - Mathematics!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33230583/838f89e80504bbe02c9f5e31af692c2cb035accf.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/905150/Trivia_Quiz_All_about_everything/

Can you count? You know what the graph of the function, the integral of the polynomial?
Then that's your topic!
We are now working on a Supplement to those already existing games and adding new topics - Mathematics.

Here you can test yourself on the knowledge of definitions, formulas, achievements of famous mathematicians, etc.

The game will be released with already updated questions and a new theme, so add to your favorites and wait! It remains to wait quite a bit)
